ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: After ignoring all curved arrows in the figure, an enolate-like organic fragment can be seen. The alkene carbon on the right is connected to a negatively charged oxygen O⁻ and also connected to a Y group; this carbon forms a C=C double bond with the alkene carbon on the left. The alkene carbon on the left is connected to R3 and connected to a saturated carbon; this saturated carbon is further connected to Nuc, R1, and R2. There is also a separate H⁺ species on the right. Reasoning: The problem asks to represent it with SMILES and ignore arrows, so generic groups such as Nuc, R1, R2, R3, and Y are all encoded as wildcard *. The negatively charged oxygen is encoded as [O-]. The central structure is C([O-])=C, where the alkene carbon on the right bears [O-] and one *, and the alkene carbon on the left bears one * and the saturated carbon C(*)(*)*. According to the alkene stereochemical relationship shown in the figure, / and \ are added, and the independent proton is appended as .[H+], giving */C([O-])=C(\*)C(*)(*)*.[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the visual structure, ignoring all curved arrows: the central organic fragment is an enolate-like alkene with one alkene carbon bonded to [O-] and Y, and the other alkene carbon bonded to R3 and to a saturated carbon carrying Nuc, R1, and R2; H+ is a separate species. Then encode each generic label as '*', encode the O with negative charge as [O-], encode the C=C between the two central carbons, attach the saturated C bearing three wildcard substituents as C(*)(*)*, add the wildcard substituent on the alkene carbon, include the depicted alkene stereochemistry with / and \, and append the separated proton as .[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中忽略所有弯曲箭头后，可以看到一个烯醇负离子样的有机片段。右侧烯烃碳连接一个带负电的氧 O⁻，同时连接一个 Y 基团；该碳与左侧烯烃碳形成 C=C 双键。左侧烯烃碳连接 R3，并连接一个饱和碳；这个饱和碳再连接 Nuc、R1 和 R2。右侧还有一个单独的 H⁺ 物种。推理：题目要求用 SMILES 表示并忽略箭头，因此把 Nuc、R1、R2、R3、Y 等通用基团都编码为通配符 *。带负电的氧编码为 [O-]。中心结构为 C([O-])=C，其中右侧烯烃碳带 [O-] 和一个 *，左侧烯烃碳带一个 * 和饱和碳 C(*)(*)*。按照图示的烯烃立体关系加入 / 和 \，并把独立质子作为 .[H+] 追加，得到 */C([O-])=C(\*)C(*)(*)*.[H+]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the natural direct-translation route: read the displayed generic transition-state skeleton as a molecular graph and encode that graph into generic SMILES with wildcard substituents. With only one image-derived structure and no answer options, substantially different solution routes are limited.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the atoms and connectivity while ignoring the curved arrows as instructed: a negatively charged oxygen attached to an alkene carbon; that carbon also bears a generic substituent Y; it is double-bonded to the adjacent carbon; the adjacent alkene carbon bears R3 and is single-bonded to a tetrahedral carbon bearing Nuc, R1, and R2. Also note the separate proton H+ shown apart from the organic fragment.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know that the required output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored rather than interpreted as changing bonds.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES conventions: represent unspecified substituent groups such as Y, R1, R2, R3, and Nuc with wildcard atoms '*'; write the enolate oxygen as [O-]; write the separate proton as [H+] after a dot; preserve the depicted alkene geometry using slash/backslash stereochemical bond markers. Convert the graph to the generic SMILES */C([O-])=C(\*)C(*)(*)*.[H+].
